top20_thumbs_low.text: The advertising for this is very misleading. Not until after you fill out the entire sign-up process are you informed that it is a paid service. It's false advertising and a deceptive intake. Beyond that, if you've set up an account but haven't paid for the subscription you can't access your profile and full settings, so you can't delete your account. You can charge for a service, but you have to disclose this in advertising and before account sign-up. Very shady and incredibly disappointing.

Not worth it. The app claims to guarantee your earnings but you have to buy credits to pay for your guaranteed earnings. They also require a subscription, minimum $15 per month. They offer a free trial to start but you quickly learn that there are connectivity issues, it drains your battery like crazy, and most of your trips are marked unclassified despite being obvious work trips. I certainly intend to cancel my free trial and uninstall this app promptly.

I downloaded and signed up. Nothing really different from the other free app I already use. If I want to use the features that are mentioned in the ad for this app, they are stuck behind a pay wall. Not mentioned in the ad at all. Bait and switch as always. Ridiculous. I have uninstalled, useless. Edit: got a response expressing that it is subscription based. That is fine. That doesn't bother as much. My problem is that the ad says nothing about that. So they reel you in with false promise

I would like to give it more, but it seems quite pointless. You need to subscribe to the app and pay them a monthly fee to get guarantees on your earnings, which might be worth it if the guarantees weren't so bare minimum and it wasn't so expensive to buy the credits to guarantee them. I bought credits that I wasn't even able to use, because I was locked out immediately after buying them, which is very shady and almost seems like a scam.

The app is not functioning properly, as the mileage tracking feature is broken. It continues to indicate that battery optimization is enabled, even when it's actually turned off. Additionally, the app is quite misleading; it makes it seem like the pay guarantee is available in every market, when in reality, it only operates in certain areas. Users are also required to purchase hourly credits on top of the monthly subscription to access this so-called pay guarantee. Overall, this app feels like a

Auto mileage tracking works, but good luck turning it off when you're not using it, You can turn on manual tracking mode, but after a short period of time, it reverts back to auto tracking. If you ride with someone else, you have to mark that trip as personal and then delete it. Also, the higher subscription tiers are a scam where you get credits to guarantee pay based on what their calculated hourly average rate is for any platform. But it's usually 50% or less of what you can actually make.

Has basically no useful features. It just wants to charge you a fee for things Doordash already does. There is no reason to download this app at all, much less pay for it. An ad convinced me to download it, but it was just false advertising. If the features aren't available everywhere, don't advertise them everywhere. It's just a scam to sucker you out of the money you are earning.

This app is very misleading. It will not connect to instacart. I had to put in my phone number several times, and it kept disconnecting it from instacart. It is connected to DoorDash fine and remains there until I try to use the app when I use the app. It disconnected. Highly not recommended. It's a gimmick. And then they have very high monthly rates for services. You can't even obtain.

The manual trip tracking toggle switch won't stay on manual when the app is closed, and the location service is draining the battery faster, and I don't believe every user would want to be tracked 24/7 outside of work. I also find it concerning that if a user decides to revert to the free version of the app, they loose all their data that they have paid for during membership. None of the other apps I have used had problems with any of it, and hopefully, it will get fixed.

No longer can track instacart or Spark Driver. I will not be renewing my subscription as it is pointless if it can't track mileage for the apps I use the most. No notification that it couldn't be used anymore, no news on the blog saying it was technical difficulties and they would be resolved soon, no news saying spark was disappearing from the app either :(

UPDATE: Based on my conversation with customer service, I have removed the app and reported them for fraud. This app is pointless, they low ball so they don't have to pay you. Then when it's time to pay you they have ever excuse in the world as to what you did wrong for them not to pay you. If you use this app I suggest screenshots to prove everything and that still might not help. I've went back and fourth with this company for weeks still haven't been paid and I am done.

Worked well with the free version, so I signed up for the paid version to help keep track of my mileage of a gig job, save your money, the app is very inconsistent with reporting mileage, I even reached out to support for a remedy, support responded with "Is the app on in the background" I responded, I always leave it running in the background, never heard anything else from support.

This app is a battery killer, eats a lot of battery even when the screen is off 3x more battery usage than Gridwise! The cpu usage and battery usage is very high, regardless of if you're working, or a gig app is in use. There HAS to be a better way to trigger monitoring rather just running all the time in the background killing the battery! maybe trigger it when a gig app is started, or at least have that as an option. No change in 6 months, this app just EATS battery!

Was good at 1st, but then they started charging us for every single hour if you wanted to get a guarantee on your salary. That's ridiculous! We're already paying a certain amount to use this stupid service, and then they want to charge you for every hour that guarantees??? definitely, definitely uninstalling this app and canceling everything because it's totally not worth it !

The worst app ever don't use or pay for a subscription. I used it for a year with the subscription and it didn't track well, couldn't link all my job accounts, when I called customer support all they would say is just keep trying it will work, and now that I have to do my taxes it won't let me download the mileage to show for. it wants me to do the taxes with them don't waste your time with this app it's junk

I like using this app overall, however for the past 3 days, I'm unable to manually track my mileage despite enabling it. When I stop the tracking, my mileage and hours simply disappear and never get added to my trip log! All it shows is "Trips processing". Then when trying to add a trip manually, since the app failed to track the whole time I was working - it does the same thing - it goes into the ether! Incredibly frustrating. Ive resorted to making notes on Google keep until you guys fix this.

It worked up until I was delivering order when confirming order complete, it would freeze every time. I'd have to restart dash and then dash wouldn't work. I had everything set up the app wanted to work with dash. Battery,location, pictures ect... So after uninstalling the solo app, dash was back and working as it should. This solo app sucks and if I could rate a zero I would

Two stars because it connected to doordash and pulled in earnings info but that's all this app was good for. After dashing non stop for a week or more it didn't auto track not one time on my phone or my in car tablet. If I have to manually click track each trip I don't see why i would purchase. Everlance was also running and tracked every trip without me touching a thing, I'll be subscribing to them. Also guaranteed earnings not available in my state so... Useless app for me.

This is an outright scam. First you have to pay a $12 monthly fee just to get access to Guaranteed payouts. Then you have for pay for Credits on top of that to secure the schedule you make; 1cred=1hr of work. And then on top of that, they review everything 2 days later, and then "adjust" the Guaranteed payouts to not pay. I work on Tues for 6hr and they say i should make $50. Only made $30 but then 2 days later. "Oh did we say $50 we meant to say $20 see you made $10 more."

I was excited about this app. They had lofty promises about a pay guarantee. I used this for an entire week and set my schedule in app. But at the end of last week...they disconnected my account from my Uber. Did not pay the guarantee. All of my data was reset. I connected my PayPal for the payout but nothing showed. This was all too good to be true. Uninstall and just manage your business for yourself.

Before this app was updated on October 7, 2022, the automatic mileage tracking feature worked like a gem on my phone. However, that update has caused the automatic mileage tracking function to be completely incapable of working. The distance, time, and tax deduction counters stay stuck at zero; the map does not appear at all; and the white dot containing an open, rotating black ring (for a "loading" map, presumably) keeps rotating. BTW, uninstalling and reinstalling the app have not helped.

This app has a fatal flaw that they have not addressed at all, there's no icon telling you it's running. It absolutely needs an icon on the notification bar when you're having it track miles. I've forgotten to turn it off so many times because I'm not thinking about the app when I finish driving. Not having something to remind users it's in use is a massive oversight.

Since the last update, the APP seems to update VERY slowly on where you have been and the milage & time. It takes sometimes hours for it to actually catch up. If you try to click on "I'm Done Driving", it just spins as it is hours behind. I've gone back and noticed that on some days, there are multiple entries of my driving on a day when I never indicated I was done driving except once. If this cannot do the basics right, it is time to look for a new app that can.
Still pretty bad. App needs serious improvement. Randomly stops tracking miles quite often.

Used to be a great app to track but now it's not what it once was. To input and track has a extended delay or doesn't want to compute, with the added doesn't want to t4sck your miles correctly has tempted me wanna switch to another app or go old school and use pen/pencil and paper. Hopefully things will one day improve.

The app isn't tracking miles correctly anymore. It skips most of all my driving and draws a line through the map to my end point. It's missing all my miles in-between start and finish. Today I drove for 3 hours and the app only tracked 18 miles.

It was a great tracking mileage tool for business purposes and I liked so much. But since last updates in December 2023 it become full of errors and glitches unuseful junk. UPDATE 09.2025 - still unreliable. Stop tracking miles randomly without error notification.

Lately this app has become unreliable. I start a trip, and when I'm finished there's no active trip so my mileage didn't get recorded. Also, when I'm trying to open the app sometimes I have to do it multiple times due to it crashing. I've cleared the cache, uninstalled/reinstalled which has not corrected the problem.

Worked well for a couple years but has gotten worse and worse. Inaccurate location tracking has gotten really bad. I'll be sitting completely still and my location will keep bouncing around the map. Trips don't sync after clicking "I'm done driving" until I close and open the app again. Trips will disappear like they never happened, but will appear again when starting a new trip. There are serious bugs.

This app keeps getting worse when trying to add weekly income. For example, yesterday was Feb 19, so I entered my income from the 12 to the 19, and it showed a ridiculous high amount of money I owe in taxes because it didn't acknowledge my deductions from the 12 to the 19. So I went back on the calendar to Feb 12 week instead of February 19, and entered my income, and it was even worse. I'm done with this app. I'll just be using it to track miles and nothing else.
This app used to be amazing, now it just fails a lot. Where is my tracking from yesterday?? If you forget to end tracking, it will just lose your mileage. Where did it go? Who knows! Awful.

This App used to track miles well. Now with the latest update it has been not tracking miles well and flat out not recording trips that were factually tracked by it. Ridiculous. Also the annoying popping up notifications for health insurance and other services are highly unproductive, the close button doesn't work well so it takes you the advertising website. Biggest thing is the failure to record trips since the last update, you have one job to do!

I have used this app for years to track my mileage. Up until not ive had little to no issues. recently, everytime i go to manually add my miles, it pops a login error:no internet connection. I have tried reinstalling the app, logging out and back in, clearing cache, restarting phone, on and off wifi, everything. nothing has fixed it and its extremely frustrating. might have to find a new app.

UPDATE : WAS better now back to bad! Permissions allowed and set not to pause when unused (other than photos and audio) but it turns off tracking on its own and records nothing! Not sure what's going on with the upgrades. I have to constantly check if it's still tracking. I've uninstalled the app hoping it would help but it's not. I allowed it permission to track when I'm using the app. The map logs of my previous trips are there for a few hours and when I look back at them they are gone.

Why they keep 'updating' this app is beyond me. Horribly inconsistent, amateur performance, and it quit tracking my miles! If they want to be rated as the "Worst Free To Use" app for mileages, well, they're doing a fantastic job! Keep it up, and no one will use your app! Not even your lip-service will save you grace!

This app was great ever since the new update. Half the time it won't even track my miles now. You need to go back to how it was. All this syncing nonsense is ridiculous too. I'll track my miles and then it'll pop up saying 2 uploads failed or vice versa. Also, what's with the quirky one liners while it's trying to load the page to track miles. It's not necessary.
Can't review a recently recorded track?

The app use to work before but lately it's not working great. Several times I have started recording my miles and then when I'm finished driving I go to the app to stop tracking only for the app to not have recorded any of my miles. The first time it happened I gave it the benefit of the doubt and said I probably forgot to turn it on. It has already happened 3 times in a week where I made sure I turned it on and then it didn't track anything.

I've recently updated my app and really wish I hadn't. It's been working great with no issues for years until this recent update. It doesn't track my drive. Just shows my starting point and straight line to my destination which cuts corners/ not accurate whatsoever. Now i have to manually add my miles. There is no longer a icon on my notification bar allowing to quickly turn it on. The auto enable while driving is no where to be found. Just horrible. Please go back to the old version.

There have been several bad updates recently. The app vanishes in the middle of a trip, the timer randomly resets, and mileage does not display accurately in the app. Sometimes I get home and it takes more than an hour for the app to catch up before it will let me stop recording mileage. App quality is declining rapidly. The app dropped over 60 mi from my driving today.
